Research & publications — Bingkun Qi

Selected research and publications on non-Hermitian photonics, parity–time symmetry and photonic zero modes.

A question to enter the research

Shaping light with gain and loss

How does amplification or absorption reshape a lattice mode?

It offers another design parameter for controlling localization.

In the studied lattices, non-Hermitian particle-hole symmetry creates a flat real spectrum. Stronger gain/loss increasingly localizes an edge-defect mode. Zero is measured relative to a reference frequency.

Bingkun Qi is the first author.

Read the source

Anchoring a zero mode at the boundary

Can a mode retain its reference frequency without global symmetry?

This suggests another route to frequency-stable photonic devices.

Coupling a boundary zero mode to the bulk under specific non-Hermitian conditions yields a zero mode robust to bulk disorder. The boundary and coupling conditions must remain satisfied.

Bingkun Qi is a co-author, listed third.
